gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Expressive and stencil-cut, Balsamiq Sans leads with a flat, bold line. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves that feel distinctly modern against the flat, single-weight stroke of Balsamiq Sans.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-hind: Crescent-wrench curves and strokes of uniform thickness give Baumans its punch. Beside that shout, Hind speaks in lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, steady as a drawn string.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans keeps its curve tails held well back from the body, a modern, tidy look beside Baumans. Long paragraphs flow smoothly here, with no hairlines to squint at.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-almarai: Wrench-wide crescents and stencil-flat strokes make Baumans hard to miss. Almarai then settles into text with a uniform line width and letters that never pinch shut, which keeps reading smooth.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans: One stroke width runs through every Baumans letter, crescent c included. Encode Sans follows with gaps that keep c from looking like o, so the pairing reads clear and orderly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Distinctive and stencil-cut, Baumans keeps every letter at one steady width. Encode Sans Expanded pulls its c tips well apart and feels approachable, the gentle quality that steadies the pair.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-finlandica: Finlandica reads clean and contemporary, with e crossbars that open their mouths wide. Baumans does commanding best, while Finlandica quietly does a constant-width outline that a finger could follow.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-gantari: Baumans arrives with a crescent c and strokes of one thickness. Gantari then reads like bent wire, with wide c openings that keep a long paragraph friendly and contemporary.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-gayathri: One crisp stroke width, one crescent c: that is Baumans. Baumans is best at a monoline skeleton, while Gayathri is best at open-ended curves with stroke contrast like a letterpress slug.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-gudea: A crescent-wrench c, opened wide, is the first thing you notice in Baumans. And Gudea follows with curves as steady as a drawn thread and glass-clear gaps at every terminal.
